title: Unsettling Lamp
description: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Triggers on the first card played in combat that applies a Debuff to an enemy. Doubles the effect of all debuffs applied by that card for the remainder of combat. Prevents double-dipping on temporary powers that internally apply debuffs.
